title: Advanced UX Designer Career Roadmap
summary: A focused pathway to deepen senior‑level UX expertise, sharpen leadership, and build a standout portfolio. Complete practical milestones, refine critique skills, and prepare for senior interviews.

phases.title: Foundations Refresh
phases.summary: Reinforce core UX concepts and tools to ensure a solid baseline.

milestones.title: Deepen User Research Foundations
milestones.outcome: Conduct comprehensive research plans and synthesize insights independently.

tasks.title: Read Nielsen Norman Group research basics
tasks.description: Study the NN/g articles on research planning and methods.

tasks.title: Create a research plan template
tasks.description: Design a reusable template in Google Docs covering goals, participants, and methods.

tasks.title: Interview two peers about a product
tasks.description: Run short 30‑minute interviews to practice question framing and note‑taking.

tasks.title: Summarize findings in an affinity map
tasks.description: Organize interview notes into themes using a free online affinity tool.

tasks.title: Reflect on bias in your questions
tasks.description: Write a brief note on any leading language and how to improve it.

milestones.title: Refresh Information Architecture
milestones.outcome: Structure content and navigation for any digital product with confidence.

tasks.title: Read IA chapter on MDN
tasks.description: Study the MDN guide on site structure and hierarchy.

tasks.title: Sketch a sitemap for a favorite app
tasks.description: Create a hand‑drawn sitemap that captures main sections and sub‑pages.

tasks.title: Create a card‑sorting test on OptimalSort free trial
tasks.description: Set up a 5‑item card sort and run it with friends.

tasks.title: Analyze results and adjust sitemap
tasks.description: Iterate the sitemap based on card‑sorting feedback.

tasks.title: Connect with a senior IA specialist on LinkedIn
tasks.description: Send a brief message asking for one tip on scaling IA for large products.

phases.title: Core Skills Mastery
phases.summary: Elevate design execution, testing, and critique to senior standards.

milestones.title: Advanced Wireframing in Figma
milestones.outcome: Produce high‑fidelity wireframes ready for handoff.

tasks.title: Complete Figma free course on wireframes
tasks.description: Follow the official Figma community tutorial series on low‑fi to hi‑fi wireframes.

tasks.title: Recreate a complex dashboard in Figma
tasks.description: Build a functional wireframe of a data dashboard using components and auto‑layout.

tasks.title: Apply design system components
tasks.description: Integrate an open‑source design system (e.g., Material) into your wireframe.

tasks.title: Gather peer feedback via Figma comments
tasks.description: Share the file with two designers and collect actionable comments.

tasks.title: Reflect on iteration speed improvements
tasks.description: Write a short note on how auto‑layout accelerated your workflow.

milestones.title: Usability Testing Excellence
milestones.outcome: Plan, run, and analyze remote usability tests with actionable recommendations.

tasks.title: Read Jakob Nielsen’s remote testing guide
tasks.description: Study the Nielsen article on remote usability testing best practices.

tasks.title: Set up a test script for a new feature
tasks.description: Write a 5‑minute task script focusing on core user goals.

tasks.title: Recruit five participants via usertesting.com free trial
tasks.description: Create a screener and schedule sessions.

tasks.title: Record and annotate test sessions
tasks.description: Use Loom to capture interactions and add timestamp notes.

tasks.title: Synthesize findings into a report template
tasks.description: Fill a pre‑made report with severity ratings and design recommendations.

milestones.title: Design Critique & Leadership
milestones.outcome: Lead constructive design critiques and mentor junior designers.

tasks.title: Read “Design Critique” article on Smashing Magazine
tasks.description: Absorb guidelines for framing feedback and fostering dialogue.

tasks.title: Facilitate a 30‑minute critique session
tasks.description: Organize a virtual critique with 3 peers on a recent project.

tasks.title: Document critique outcomes in a shared board
tasks.description: Create a Trello board summarizing feedback and action items.

tasks.title: Mentor a junior on wireframe iteration
tasks.description: Spend an hour reviewing their work and giving growth suggestions.

tasks.title: Reflect on your facilitation style
tasks.description: Write a brief self‑assessment of what worked and what to improve.

phases.title: Proof of Work
phases.summary: Create portfolio‑ready case studies that showcase senior‑level impact.

milestones.title: Redesign App Case Study
milestones.outcome: Publish a detailed redesign narrative with before/after flows.

tasks.title: Select an app you use daily
tasks.description: Choose a product with clear usability pain points to redesign.

tasks.title: Conduct 3 user interviews
tasks.description: Gather qualitative data about current frustrations.

tasks.title: Create new IA and wireframes in Figma
tasks.description: Develop revised sitemap and wireframes for key screens.

tasks.title: Write the case study narrative
tasks.description: Structure the write‑up with problem, process, solution, and impact sections.

tasks.title: Publish on Behance and share on LinkedIn
tasks.description: Upload visuals, add tags, and announce the project to your network.

milestones.title: Usability Study with Participants
milestones.outcome: Demonstrate end‑to‑end testing methodology and data‑driven recommendations.

tasks.title: Define research questions for a prototype
tasks.description: Focus on navigation efficiency and error rates.

tasks.title: Recruit 5 participants via social media
tasks.description: Post a brief invitation and schedule sessions.

tasks.title: Run remote moderated tests
tasks.description: Guide participants through tasks while recording screen and voice.

tasks.title: Analyze metrics and create findings deck
tasks.description: Use Google Sheets to calculate task success and time, then design slides.

tasks.title: Add the study to your portfolio site
tasks.description: Create a dedicated project page with screenshots and key takeaways.

milestones.title: Onboarding Flow Prototype
milestones.outcome: Showcase a complete interactive prototype that improves first‑time user experience.

tasks.title: Map onboarding user journey
tasks.description: Outline steps from sign‑up to first success metric.

tasks.title: Design low‑fi screens in Figma
tasks.description: Create a series of 5 screens covering each onboarding step.

tasks.title: Add interactions and transitions
tasks.description: Use Figma prototyping features to simulate flow.

tasks.title: Conduct a quick 5‑person test
tasks.description: Observe participants completing the onboarding and note friction points.

tasks.title: Iterate prototype based on feedback
tasks.description: Refine screens and interactions to address identified issues.

phases.title: Getting Ready
phases.summary: Polish leadership presence, advanced topics, and senior‑level interview readiness.

milestones.title: Advanced Design Systems
milestones.outcome: Create and maintain a reusable design system for cross‑team use.

tasks.title: Study Figma design system documentation
tasks.description: Read the official Figma guide on libraries and tokens.

tasks.title: Audit an existing component library
tasks.description: Identify gaps and inconsistencies in a public UI kit.

tasks.title: Build a custom component library
tasks.description: Create 10 core components with variants and auto‑layout.

tasks.title: Write usage guidelines for the library
tasks.description: Document component purpose, states, and accessibility notes in a shared file.

tasks.title: Present the system to a peer group
tasks.description: Lead a 20‑minute walkthrough and gather feedback.

milestones.title: Leadership & Strategy
milestones.outcome: Lead UX strategy sessions and mentor junior designers effectively.

tasks.title: Read “Strategic Design Leadership” article on A List Apart
tasks.description: Absorb frameworks for aligning UX with business goals.

tasks.title: Facilitate a 1‑hour strategy workshop
tasks.description: Guide a cross‑functional team through problem framing and solution mapping.

tasks.title: Create a UX roadmap template
tasks.description: Design a reusable slide deck for future project planning.

tasks.title: Mentor a junior on their first case study
tasks.description: Provide step‑by‑step feedback and help them polish deliverables.

tasks.title: Reflect on leadership challenges faced
tasks.description: Write a short journal entry on what you learned and next steps.

milestones.title: Senior Interview Preparation
milestones.outcome: Confidently articulate experience, solve design challenges, and negotiate offers.

tasks.title: Review common senior UX interview questions
tasks.description: Study lists from UX Design CC and note key themes.

tasks.title: Craft STAR stories for three major projects
tasks.description: Write concise narratives highlighting Situation, Task, Action, Result.

tasks.title: Do a mock whiteboard exercise
tasks.description: Set a timer for 45 minutes and solve a design problem on paper.

tasks.title: Record yourself answering a behavioral question
tasks.description: Play back to assess clarity and confidence, then refine.

tasks.title: Connect with a senior UX recruiter on LinkedIn
tasks.description: Ask for feedback on your portfolio and interview approach.
